about: Sleep Talk calls a sound move Throat Chop stops, and the move fails as it is used, from the seventh generation (Pokemon Central, Sonnolalia: "le mosse sonore bloccate dallo stato di Colpo Infernale possono essere estratte, ma falliranno durante l'esecuzione"; Showdown's gen-9 throatchop condition stops a called move in onModifyMove). Before, Sleep Talk's pick left the move out (StruggleCheck), and with nothing else to call failed. A level-10 Pikachu, put to sleep (set:), is given Sleep Talk and Growl in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Throat Chop and is made the faster (set:). The Throat Chop lands; the sleeping Pikachu's Sleep Talk calls Growl, which Throat Chop stops (MoveStoppedByThroatChop). The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The wild Chansey used Throat Chop!
